name: FFS_CML_SHAPE_STATUS
description: Stores upload statuses for custom map layers.

columns.name: PROGRESS
columns.description: Import status: pending, succeeded, failed, cancelled.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Shapefile import start date as timestamp.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Shapefile import end date as timestamp.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of import as http code(200, 404, 500).

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of error; if success then null.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: Error title set during upload processing.

columns.name: MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message set during upload processing.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
